items.title: Regularity of a ring map to a Noetherian ring is a local property
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that regularity of a ring map into a Noetherian ring can be checked at all pairs of primes lying over one another, or equivalently at maximal ideals of the target lying over maximal ideals of the source. The statement carries a title naming it as a local property. The proof reduces both conditions to their local counterparts: a Noetherian ring is regular exactly when all its local rings are regular, and a ring map is flat exactly when all induced maps of local rings are flat, so the global conditions and the local ones are the same.
